scanner.permissionBody: Threadbase needs camera access to scan a pairing QR code shown by your server.
scanner.permissionHint: Camera access is disabled. Open Settings to enable it for Threadbase.
scanner.reticleHint: Point at the QR shown by your server

uri.invalid: That QR doesn't look like a Threadbase pair code.
uri.expired: This pair QR has expired. Run tb pair on your server again.
uri.bad-server-url: The server URL in this QR is not valid.

exchange.token: Pair token rejected — generate a fresh QR on your server.
exchange.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
exchange.network: Could not reach that server. Check that the streamer is running and your phone is on the same network.
exchange.decrypt: Server response could not be decrypted.
exchange.server: The server responded unexpectedly. Update the streamer to the latest version and try again.
exchange.cleartext: This server is reachable only over plain HTTP and is not on your local network. Use an https:// address, or run tb serve --tunnel.
exchange.e2ee-handshake: Could not verify this server's identity. Your pairing code is still valid — scan it again, and if this keeps happening, generate a fresh one on your server.
exchange.e2ee-malformed: This app and the server disagreed on the encrypted pairing. Your pairing code is still valid — try scanning it again.
exchange.e2ee-version: This server encrypts pairing in a version this app does not speak. Update the app and the streamer to matching versions.

confirm.title: Add this server?
confirm.encryptedLine: Encrypted from this device to this computer.
confirm.compareHint: Run tb-streamer identity on the computer you're pairing with and compare it to the fingerprint above.
confirm.noSpkBody: This server isn't offering encryption, so there's nothing to compare — anything you send will be readable by anything between this device and the server.
confirm.apiKeyTitle: Add server with a pasted key?
confirm.apiKeyBody: This key was typed or pasted, not exchanged with the server. It can't be tied to a specific device or verified — only use a key from a source you trust.
